coverage.canonicalPolicy: Full canonical rules append once; headings alone cannot suppress them; repeated application preserves existing array blocks and metadata.
coverage.unknownAndFailedUsage: Partial or missing usage, failed completions and thrown errors retain their reservations. Inconsistent totals and excessive output reject without discount.
coverage.multiAttemptAccounting: Potential two-attempt requests retain the full conservative reservation because returned usage can cover only the final attempt. Default retry behavior remains unchanged.
coverage.queuedWork: Targeted tests and independent probes verify cancellation, shared deadline, lowered call caps, settled budget exhaustion, live authorization rechecks and termination without hidden retries or queued deadlock.
coverage.authorization: Actual HTTP revocation after the first two provider calls prevents queued physical calls and all proposals; polling returns 403 and the job cannot finish done.
coverage.defaults: Team remains disabled by default; maxCalls 4, maxTokensPerCall 2400, totalTokens 100000, timeoutMs 45000 and maxInputBytes 64000 remain unchanged.
